name: GitLab: the API Keys row and the add-repo copy that let a GitLab project in
description: Covers the GitLab surface that is reachable WITHOUT credentials or a live instance: the GitLab PAT row in Settings → API Keys (its label and its scope hint), and the add-repository screen accepting a GitLab URL in its copy. DELIBERATELY NOT COVERED: importing a real GitLab project, listing merge requests, or posting a discussion — all three need a reachable GitLab instance and a PAT, and flows here run key-free against seeded read-only fixtures. Those paths are covered by server/test/gitlab.it.test.ts (routing, dedupe, degradation) and server/test/gitlab-adapter.test.ts (payload mapping) instead. Read-only: presses nothing that writes.
